context: The conventional Sørensen coefficient and 95% CI were already known in RC7; this is therefore a bounded robustness test, not a preregistered equivalence analysis.
response: wet-minus-dry mean pairwise Sørensen dissimilarity among active stops
model: delta_sorensen ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), cluster-robust by State x RouteNumber
margin_rationale: 2.5 percentage points on the bounded 0-1 Sørensen dissimilarity scale per unit log-rainfall contrast; deliberately tighter than the existing +/-0.05 matrix-fill margin.
decision_rule: practical equivalence if the complete 90% confidence interval for the rainfall-contrast coefficient lies within [-0.025,+0.025]
sensitivity: apply the identical margin and rule to exact consecutive-year pairs
title_support_rule: equivalence wording for Sørensen is authorized only if both the primary and exact-consecutive-year analyses pass
